title: Remember Me, I will remember you
arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
latin: Fadzkuruni adzkurkum washkuru li wa la takfurun
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
lesson: The greatest honor: Allah remembers you when you remember Him. Dhikr is not small, it's a direct connection.
